answer: Each agent must post a bonded proof-of-reserves balance attested by independent ledger reconciliation, so a sybil cluster cannot mint identities without locking distinct capital as jade seal in a guarded garden. Colluding wallets that co-sign for each other are flagged by forensic graph analysis across the ocean of transactions, since shared funding roots. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
